costs.scope: All fixed candidate selection and technical repair attempts from v030 through SWE v032. Excludes pre-v030 9B training cost, model download time, CPU development/testing, external unrelated jobs and monetary pricing.
costs.cost_definition: Worker GPU seconds are complete controller-assigned single-GPU process wall durations, including loading, diagnostics, screening, teardown and failure; not utilization-weighted device computation.
anti_double_counting: Use the individual incremental worker fields, not the sum of stage supervisor.worker_gpu_seconds or cumulative state.elapsed_gpu_seconds.
Retained 9B symlinks/reports in r1 and v031 refer to its one original v030 7028.481027-second worker and 365 generated calls; they add zero new cost/calls/episodes.
r1 elapsed_gpu_seconds already includes the failed original v030 load; add only recovery_worker_gpu_seconds for r1.
v031 admission proof actual_worker_gpu_seconds is the full parent-assigned probe lifetime; worker_body_seconds is an included subinterval and must not be added.
v031 cumulative components already include v030, r1 and old-trace proof. Add only v031_worker_gpu_seconds for that formal runtime attempt.
r2 cumulative includes v031. v032 cumulative includes r2. Their new increments are respectively v031r2_worker_gpu_seconds and v032_worker_gpu_seconds.
Deduplicate reservation state.json against attempt-N-result.json by child PID/start_ticks; watcher duration overlaps child holding time and must not be added to it.

Reservation ready-to-end is a bookkeeping wall interval between allocation readiness and child termination, separately reported; not exact GPU computation or proven exclusive occupancy after the last heartbeat. Do not silently include it in model-worker ranking cost.
Controller-to-assignment waits overlap across candidates and with other GPU work; report per candidate and do not sum them as a global wall deadline or GPU cost.
Count original resident/calls files once per newly executed worker. A saved response replay or re-referenced historical probability/update receipt is not a new sampled model call or optimizer step.

Three executed aggregate technical updates each contain one actor and one critic optimizer step, then restore common. They are not formal-screen training; all formal screening optimizer steps are zero.
Original 9B restored actor/critic counters are 3/3 from prior work; do not mislabel those terminal counters as new selection updates.

interpretation_limits: The models have different pretraining/posttraining, inherited project states, native codecs and revision histories; no causal model-size ranking.
Only two seeds and one Marshmallow repository; category counts are descriptive, not independent broad generalization estimates.
The 36 development episodes are ineligible for training or independent confirmation; no B/G-raw/I-P comparison occurred.
Native parser/gradient/capacity evidence and reversible diagnostic steps are not business learning gains.
The v032 zero-argument diagnostic did not pass its third requested operation, so its 12 planned business slots never started and are not 0/12 failures.
Exact-token budget replay on two old SWE requests would admit those requests but neither resumes old work nor proves delivery improvement.
